ksquare_bsa.meta: Donation & fundraising platform • React / Node / MySQL

bullets.1: Architected async data flows with Redux and RxJS to improve reliability under high-traffic campaigns.
bullets.2: Built and maintained REST APIs with Node.js and Express, supporting core donation and reporting workflows.
bullets.3: Improved delivery workflows with Git flow and CI/CD streamlining for faster, safer production releases.

bullets.2: Optimized caching and state flows to improve UX responsiveness while reducing unnecessary API load.
